translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. E dwol mar “Kik iketh gik moko.” Miktam
mar Daudi. Kane Saulo ooro ji mondo ocher od Daudi mondo onege.

content.text: Resa e lwet wasika, yaye Nyasaye;
Rit ngimana kuom joma ogar koda.
Gola e lwet joma timo gik maricho
kendo resa kuom joma riyo mar chwero remo omako.
Neye kaka gibutona ka girita e yo!
Joma kwiny chano kaka digihinya,
to an onge gima rach kata richo masetimo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
Onge gima asetimo marach,
to kata kamano gin to giikore monja.
Aa malo ikonya; ne chandruokna.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye Maratego,
in Nyasach Israel,
aa malo ikum ogendini duto;
kik ikech andhoke ma timbegi richo. Sela
Gidwogo ka piny imore,
ka gingʼur ka guogi,
kendo giwuotho koni gi koni e dala ka gingʼanjo.
Neye gik ma gingʼudho koa e dhogi,
gingʼudho ligengni gi dhogi,
kendo giwacho niya, “En ngʼa manyalo winjowa?”
To in nyiergi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
go siboi ne ogendinigo duto.
Yaye tekona, in ema angʼiyi,
in e kar pondona, yaye Nyasaye,
Yaye Nyasacha ma jahera.
Nyasaye biro telona
kendo obiro miyo asungra ne joma ketho nyinga.
To kik uneg-gi, yaye Ruoth ma okumbana
nikech joga dipoka wigi owil.
Mi giba abaya koni gi koni gi tekoni,
kendo mi gidog piny.
Nikech richo ma gitimo gi dhogi kuom wuoyo,
nikech weche mawuok e dhogi,
wegi mondo sungagi ogajgi.
Nikech gikwongʼo ji kendo gi wuondo ji,
tiekgi gi mirimbi mager,
tiekgi mi kargi lal nono,
eka biro ngʼere e tungʼ piny koni gi koni
ni Nyasaye nigi loch kuom joka Jakobo. Sela
Gidwogo ka piny imore
ka gingʼur ka guogi,
kendo giwuotho koni gi koni e dala ka gingʼanjo.
Gibayo koni gi koni ka gidwaro chiemo
kendo ka ok giyiengʼ to gingʼur.
Anto abiro wer kuom tekoni
abiro wero herani gokinyi;
nikech in e ohingana,
in e kar pondona e kinde mag thagruok.
In e tekona, omiyo abiro weroni wend pak;
in e ohingana, yaye Nyasaye,
in e Nyasacha ma jahera.

footnotes.text: Miktam: Ochalo ni en kit wer moro
